description: A chart series: tx_count, fees_total, fees_median, block_size, difficulty, hashrate, supply, price_usd, tx_per_min, block_interval, mempool_txs, mempool_bytes, pool_share, holder_share, new_addresses, active_addresses, transfers, lookalikes, on LTC and LTCTEST mweb_pool (coins in MWEB) and mweb_flows (peg-ins and peg-outs), and on ZEC and ZECTEST zcash_pools (the value in each Zcash pool). Intervals: block (last 1,000 blocks), hour (90 days), day (full history), minute (last hour; tx_per_min and mempool series only).

currency.description: Optional, price_usd only: the price in this currency instead of USD.

from.description: Optional start: block height for the block interval, else unix time.

interval.description: Each point's span: block (the last 1,000 blocks), minute (the last hour), hour (90 days) or day (the full history).

network.description: Network: BTC, LTC, DOGE, ZEC, BTCTEST, LTCTEST, DOGETEST or ZECTEST.

series.description: The series, as listed above: mweb_pool and mweb_flows on Litecoin only, zcash_pools on Zcash only.

to.description: Optional end, same units as from.

name: get_chart
title: Chart Series
